card.name: Word endings in label section text
card.fires_on: Responds to the last piece of a word, or the first word after a heading, in drug-label sections on pregnancy, toxicity criteria or dosing. Examples are the end of miscarriage, the ity in Toxicity, and the word after Risk Summary.

modes.label: Ends of medical words
modes.description: The final piece of a long medical term such as miscarriage, Toxicity or dialysis.
modes.example: The estimated background risk of major birth defects and miscar<<riage>> for the indicated population(s) is unknown

modes.label: Word right after a heading
modes.description: The first word of text after a section heading such as Risk Summary or Thyroid Accumulation.
modes.example: PREGNANCY Risk Summary<< Use>> of NSAIDs, including Etodol

modes.label: Small words in risk phrases
modes.description: Short words like of or all inside phrases about incidence or ages.
modes.example: have been associated with an increased risk of tendinitis and tendon rupture in<< all>> ages [see Warnings and Preca

card.plain: It fires on the last piece of a medical word or the first word after a label heading, where the phrase is nearly finished.
